newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia sells dog meat across border to China.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia sells dog meat across border to China.

text.p: Mongolia has found money to be made in selling the meat from stray dogs across the border to a company in China, Mongolia's Montsame news agency said on Wednesday.
Dogs were selling for 150 Chinese yuan ($18.0) each to the Altan Emeel company in China, the news agency said.

In Choibalsan, capital of Mongolia's eastern Dornod province, dogs cost 6,000 tugriks ($8.25) each, it said. With strays becoming rarer on city streets, hunters were now targeting family pets, Montsame said.
Dog meat is a popular delicacy in China.
